sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Artistic Branch

system.description:
You mold clay, earth or another inorganic earthen substance into the shape of a single bird of your description that seems to come to life temporarily listening to your commands known as a Clay Bird into a space of your choice within range.

The Clay Bird has the listed statistics found on its stat block at the end of this clan and uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus or Save DC when an effect calls for it. You can command them as an Action or Bonus action. You can have one Clay Bird active at a time.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, you can summon a second Clay Bird.
